source_gap.facts: prepare() only fills layout_restore_normal from product-owned layout history; begin() only uses that saved own history for nonmaximized restored intent. The maximized restore arm is based on fresh.maximized. External native-Snap windows are nonmaximized in actual capture and have no native-arranged state or normal-intent path, so this g2 is accepted as an ordinary large Move. Cancellation/END happened before any native restoration, and the current handoff predicate also disallows unexplained size changes.
source_gap.minimum_missing_capability: Reliably observe native arranged state and carry a verified restoration intent through the existing bounded restore observation path while keeping the true original DOWN anchor. Native/Shell identity, unknown-state rejection, capture/UP revocation and geometry continuity remain required. Do not simply accept arbitrary DOWN/END size changes or infer arranged from half-screen geometry/old normal-position differences.
